reviews.title: Amazing case!
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this case. It has so much space and it’s just so easy to work in. Not to mention the airflow is just as you’d expect. I’m running a 9070 xt and a 14900k and I never see high temps. To be fair I use an AIO but even then my GPU stays nice and cool.
